inference_preprocessing: Embedded MobileNetV2 preprocessing in the saved model; resize and RGB conversion only in the prediction script.

prediction_policy.detection_rule: A condition is detected when its score is greater than or equal to its locked threshold.
prediction_policy.unknown_labels: Unknown labels were excluded from evaluation; the script does not infer missing source labels.

operational_limit: Predictions support report triage only. A qualified human must confirm every road condition; the model does not determine severity, danger, repair priority, cost, or road safety.
